title: Intra-Architecture Source Attribution for Stable Diffusion: A New Task with Benchmark Dataset and Baseline
abstract: arXiv:2611.06000v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Designing systems that attribute a generated image to its source model has lately become a major area of AI research. Most existing datasets and systems related to image source attribution are targeted towards the detection of architectural signatures of the source models. Distinct from this, focusing on stable diffusion, we introduce a novel task, IntrAA-SD, Intra-Architecture source Attribution for Stable Diffusion, where the source models to be differentiated share the same architectural backbone and differ only due to fine-tuning. The proposed task aligns with the emergence of fine-tuned generators having the same architecture, like Juggernaut XL and RealVis XL, which are fine-tuned versions of Stable Diffusion XL (SDXL). We provide a first-of-its-kind $140$K-image benchmark dataset containing images generated from different fine-tunes of SDXL, along with in-domain and out-of-distribution prompts. translated_title: 面向Stable Diffusion的架构内来源归因：一项新任务及其基准数据集与基线方法
translated_abstract: 设计能够将生成图像归因到其源模型的系统，近来已成为人工智能研究的一个重要领域。现有大多数与图像来源归因相关的数据集和系统，主要针对检测源模型的架构特征。与此不同，本文聚焦于Stable Diffusion，提出了一项新颖的任务——IntrAA-SD（面向Stable Diffusion的架构内来源归因），该任务中需要区分的源模型共享相同的架构骨干，仅因微调而彼此不同。所提出的任务与拥有相同架构的微调生成器的兴起相契合，例如Juggernaut XL和RealVis XL，它们都是Stable Diffusion XL（SDXL）的微调版本。我们提供了首个此类包含14万张图像的基准数据集，其中包含由SDXL不同微调版本生成的图像，以及域内和分布外提示词。此外，我们还提供了一个基线框架。
tldr: 本文提出了新任务IntrAA-SD，旨在区分共享相同架构但经过不同微调的Stable Diffusion模型，并提供了首个包含14万张图像的基准数据集及基线方法。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces IntrAA-SD, a novel task for attributing generated images to fine-tuned variants of Stable Diffusion sharing the same architecture, along with a first-of-its-kind 140K-image benchmark dataset and a baseline framework.
